gen-gf-grandstander-gf-oxygen: Oxygen is a plain sans with lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals. Grandstander up top draws bold, expressive letters with no swell from thick to thin, so size the Oxygen text a notch up and let it breathe beneath.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-questrial: Distinctive and bold, Gugi has lowercase that nearly reaches its capitals, with open-cut terminals. And Questrial, a modern sans-serif, matches that height with single-weight strokes that feel stencil-cut.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-mahajani: Tall lowercase and a funnel-wide throat in the e make this body read modern and sharply drawn. Noto Sans Mahajani then sits under Audiowide, whose tubular strokes look like bent copper pipe.
gen-gf-offside-gf-sofia-sans-semi-conden: Offside refuses to close its curves, and its widely tracked letters march along at a level beat. Sofia Sans Semi Condensed gives it a sturdy partner.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-stack-sans-headline: Stack Sans Headline reads friendly and crisp, with a deep middle band and wide gaps that keep tiny sizes sharp. But Revalia keeps its g open below, while the body holds a monoline thickness that steadies a longer run of text.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-sono: Expressive and loud, Snowburst One looks like a stencil sheet with wide bridges between its tall letters. Sono follows quietly, spaced wide with each a left ajar.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-sen: Tektur looks like bent pipe cleaners, oversized and full of open curves. Sen carries a longer passage with tall lowercase and one constant line, so the reading stays modern and smooth.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-stack-sans-notch: Stack Sans Notch reads big-bodied and open, with curves you can see right into and rod-stock strokes throughout. But Tilt Neon's tube-like lines and large x-height give the pair its strongest quality: a shared, uniform stroke.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-sintony: Sintony reads smooth and chunky, with a tall midzone and curves that never clog up with ink. Unica One shares that clarity, its ruler-straight strokes letting daylight into every bend.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-ubuntu-sans: Wallpoet's tall lowercase leaves paper showing between letters. Ubuntu Sans, a plain sans with copper-pipe strokes and no brush-like swell, matches that openness.
